verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1638). Measures the consequence by running the real public/sw.js in a node vm sandbox with a fake cache and network: install then activate removes an earlier frequency- cache; a page load with signal returns the network page and nothing for it is stored; an /api/ GET is neither answered nor stored; with the network down a page load returns exactly public/offline.html and a build file loaded earlier still comes back. Also fails if public/offline.html is missing, carries an em dash or loads a /_next/ file, or the push handlers are gone. Fails on main at fb91c7b48 (no offline page; with one added, no fetch handler). Mutation-fired: each of the ten arms fails when its condition is broken.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1638). PREMISE HELD on main at fb91c7b48: public/sw.js had no fetch listener and its header said "No offline caching yet". WHAT CHANGED. (1) public/offline.html: a standalone page (inline DAWN light and dark values, the app icon, no build asset), "You're offline", one plain line, "Try again", and a reload on the online event. No em dashes. (2) public/sw.js gains its own install, activate and fetch listeners below the push handlers, which are byte-for-byte unchanged. Install precaches /offline.html and the icon into frequency-offline-v1 (a failed precache is caught so push still installs, and navigations then get a short inline page, 503). Page loads (same-origin GET navigations) are network first and NEVER stored; only when fetch rejects is the offline page served. /_next/static/ is cache first and /icons/, /images/ network first with a stored fallback, stored only for a same-origin 200 without no-store or private, capped at 150 entries. Non-GET, cross-origin, /api/, RSC fetches, /_next/image, /_next/data and range requests get no respondWith. Activate deletes any frequency- cache that is not current. The practice-timer promise in the filing was dropped: the timer is a page and pages are not stored. TESTS: test/contract/offline-worker.test.ts evaluates the real worker in a vm global with fake caches and fetch (17 tests); mutation-checked (storing a navigation, caching /api/, no precache, no cleanup, storing private, a rejecting install each fail). No migration, no dependency, nothing new reachable from app-shell.
